secure_findings_list.description: Input validation gap: The `Path.GetExtension` method is used to extract the file extension, which may not cover all possible file types. Consider using a more robust method, such as `System.IO.Path.GetExtension(file.FileName, out var extension)`.
secure_findings_list.fix: Use `System.IO.Path.GetExtension(file.FileName, out var extension)` to extract the file extension and improve input validation. See https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.io.path.getextension?view=net-6.0 for more information. (Severity: LOW)
